svg.text: A flat: Re ζ, Im ζ (t not drawn)
dots on the real axis = Gram points gₙ, n ≥ 0 (θ = nπ)
B UNS end-on: ρ = log₁₀|ζ| + 3, angle = arg ζ
axis = zero set; ρ = 0 at the floor (rendering choice)
C log₁₀|ζ| against t (zeros = spikes to the floor)
D the lost clock: −θ(t)/π (Gram points at integers)
turning point θ′ = 0 at t = 2π; rate −θ′ = −½ ln(t/2π)
colour = t (violet 0 → yellow 50). Orthographic. Spring: ρ = log₁₀|ζ| + 3 (clipped at 0), φ = arg ζ, z = 0.06·t. Zeros sit on the axis.
